trello.name: Sign venue contract and confirm AV recording
trello.desc: Diego to get the convention center contract (main hall plus two breakout rooms, $18,000, catering separate) through legal review and signed by end of next week, and confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms.

trello.name: Lock speaker lineup
trello.desc: Bo to send final follow-ups to the two maybe speakers with a decision deadline of Friday, use the backup list of five names if either falls through, and have the full nine-speaker lineup locked within two weeks so the agenda can be printed.

trello.name: Obtain keynote abstract from Dr. Osei
trello.desc: Bo to chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week; it is needed for the website and the printed program.

trello.name: Draft and run three-wave email campaign
trello.desc: Diego to draft all three email campaign waves this month: agenda announcement when Bo locks the lineup (first wave goes out the day the agenda is live), early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change, and a final-week push.

trello.name: Hand off speaker bios and headshots same day
trello.desc: Bo, once the lineup locks, to hand speaker bios and headshots straight to Diego the same day for the landing page update.

trello.name: Update website speaker pages before wave one
trello.desc: Diego to update the website/landing page with speaker pages using the bios and headshots from Bo before the first email campaign wave goes out.

trello.name: Approve swag design proofs
trello.desc: Camille to review and approve the swag design proofs in the shared drive today so the order can be placed this week given the six-week lead time.

trello.name: Place swag order
trello.desc: Diego to place the swag order this week once Camille approves the proofs: 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, 1,000 stickers, approximately $9,200 including the rush buffer.
